facts.activity_file: working live under a documented justification

control_failures.control_label: application of positive isolation devices and personal locks
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.title: audit finding - permit to work records incomplete for G-8101

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on G-8101, G-8103 and TT-8101 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically working live under a documented justification. G-8101 (gas turbine generators) is in service for on-site generation. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 12 April 2019 a planned critical control verification of G-8101, G-8103 and TT-8101 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station found the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks not effective.
